css.name: --ok-font-family
css.value: "Nunito Variable", "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

events.description: Before the dialog closes. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it open.
events.name: ok:dialog:beforeclose

events.description: Before the dialog opens. Call `preventDefault()` to keep it closed.
events.name: ok:dialog:beforeopen

events.description: After the dialog closed (once its exit animation ended and the focus is back), with what closed it (`native`: a form with `method="dialog"`).
events.name: ok:dialog:close

events.description: After the dialog opened. `trigger` is the element that opened it, if any.
events.name: ok:dialog:open

methods.description: Closes it after its exit animation (`ok:dialog:close` fires then). Returns `false` if `ok:dialog:beforeclose` was prevented.
methods.name: close

methods.description: Opens the dialog. Returns `false` if `ok:dialog:beforeopen` was prevented.
methods.name: open

options.description: Takes the whole `maxWidth`, even with little content.
options.name: fullWidth

options.description: Covers the viewport, without corners or margins.
options.name: fullScreen

options.description: `paper`: the content scrolls inside the dialog; `body`: the whole dialog scrolls.
options.name: scroll

options.description: Focus isn't moved back to the element focused before it opened.
options.name: disableRestoreFocus

options.description: The page behind can still scroll while it is open.
options.name: disableScrollLock

options.description: Entrance of the paper: a Motion entrance (`slideInUp`, `zoomIn`…); without it, a short fade and scale.
options.name: transition

options.description: Length of the entrance in ms (React also `{ enter, exit }`; HTML exit: `data-ok-transition-duration-exit`). Default: the theme's short durations.
options.name: transitionDuration

options.description: Shadow depth of the paper, `0`–`24` (`--ok-elevation-<n>`). Without it, the theme's dialog shadow.
options.name: elevation

options.description: Open state (`open` / `onOpenChange`; HTML: a trigger or `open()`).
options.name: open

parts.description: Closes the dialog whose `id` it names, or, without a value, the dialog it sits in.
parts.name: data-ok-dialog-close

parts.description: Opens the dialog whose `id` it names.
parts.name: data-ok-dialog-open

parts.description: The dialog's surface, a Paper (with `data-ok-paper`; `data-ok-elevation` sets its shadow).
parts.name: data-ok-dialog-paper

parts.description: Draws lines above and below the content.
parts.name: data-ok-dividers

parts.description: The length of the exit in milliseconds, when it differs from `data-ok-transition-duration`.
parts.name: data-ok-transition-duration-exit

react.description: A modal `<dialog data-ok-dialog>` (native top layer, inert page, focus trap; fallback without `showModal()`) with the paper inside. Controlled, like MUI: keep `open` in state. Named by its `DialogTitle` (automatic `aria-labelledby`). Focus returns to the element focused before it opened.

props.description: Focus isn't moved back to the element focused before the dialog opened.
props.name: disableRestoreFocus

props.description: The page behind can still scroll while the dialog is open.
props.name: disableScrollLock

props.description: Shadow depth of the paper, 0–24 (`--ok-elevation-<n>`). Default: the theme's dialog shadow. The paper is a Paper.
props.name: elevation

props.description: Keeps the children rendered while the dialog is closed. (the HTML markup is always there too); `false` renders them only while it is open (MUI's default), which resets their state on every opening.
props.name: keepMounted

props.description: Called when the dialog asks to close: `"escape"`, `"backdrop"` (a click outside the paper) or `"close"` (the browser closed it, for example a `form[method=dialog]`).
props.name: onOpenChange

props.description: `paper` (default): the content scrolls; `body`: the whole dialog scrolls.
props.name: scroll

props.description: Entrance of the paper: a Motion entrance (`slideInUp`, `zoomIn`…). Without it, the paper fades and scales in briefly.
props.name: transition

props.description: Length of the entrance and the exit in ms, or each on its own (`{ enter, exit }`). Default: 250 ms in, 200 ms out (a `transition` uses Motion's lengths). The dialog closes when its exit ends.
props.name: transitionDuration

html.description: The row of actions at the bottom.

react.description: The row of buttons at the end of the dialog.
The scrollable body of the dialog.

props.description: Lines above and below the content (and 16px padding).
props.name: dividers

html.description: A paragraph of the content, in the secondary text color.
The title. Name the dialog with it through `aria-labelledby`.

react.description: The dialog's heading (`h2`); it names the dialog.

types.name: DialogTransitionDuration
types.type: number | { enter?: number | undefined; exit?: number | undefined; }
